regions.today: Dry this evening with some good sunshine.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight but becoming largely cloudy. A few spots of drizzle are possible. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees in light southwesterly or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly cloudy tomorrow with occasional rain and drizzle possible. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees in light, occasionally moderate southwesterly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate Saturday and moderate to high Sunday.
